brief.goal: Generate appointment bookings for HVAC services

audience.description: Homeowners in a few local ZIP codes

brief.desiredRecipientAction: Scan a QR code to fill out a form on the website, or call the phone number, to book an appointment

primarySuccessMetric.description: Appointments booked via QR code form submissions or phone calls

brief.emotionalTone: Warm and trustworthy, yet professional and modern — conveying reliability as a local company homeowners can trust

transcript.content: I own an HVAC company and want to send 1,000 mailers to homeowners in a few local ZIP codes. I want the mailer to generate appointments. I'd like a QR code that takes people to a form on my website, and I also want my phone number on the mailer so people can call us.

Got it — an HVAC mailer aimed at booking appointments, sent to 1,000 homeowners in a few local ZIP codes, with a QR code linking to your website form and your phone number as a backup contact method. 

A couple quick things to nail down the details: what's your business name (and do you want your address on the mailer too), and what's the specific website URL the QR code should point to?
The business is Cool Air HVAC. Our address is 123 Main Street, Irvine, CA 92618. The website URL is https://example.com/book

Perfect, that gives us the core business details. Do you have a logo you'd like included on the mailer, and is there any special offer or discount you want to feature (like a seasonal tune-up discount or a percentage off a service) to give people extra incentive to book?
Yes, include our logo. Offer 20% off a first-time service call.

Great, a 20% off first-time service call is a strong hook to drive bookings. Last thing — what kind of feeling do you want the mailer to give off? For example, should it feel urgent and deal-focused, warm and trustworthy, or professional and reliable?
Warm and trustworthy, but still professional and modern. I want homeowners to feel like we're a reliable local company they can trust.

That's a great direction — warm and trustworthy with a modern, professional polish will resonate well with homeowners choosing a local HVAC provider. I think we've got everything needed for a strong first draft: 1,000 mailers to homeowners in your local ZIP codes, driving appointment bookings via QR code (linking to your booking form) or phone call, featuring Cool Air HVAC's logo, address, and a 20% off first-time service offer, with a warm, trustworthy, professional tone. Ready for me to put together the campaign brief for your review?
